decision: Row chunking is mathematically equivalent under the conditions below; this is not execution approval
original_operation: Pinned function lines 147-174 allocates zero im2col(N*V,Ci), masks neighbor_map.view(-1) against 0xffffffff, gathers full feats at global neighbor indices, views im2col(N,V*Ci), then uses weight.view(Co,V*Ci).transpose(0,1) with the original torch.mm or torch.addmm(bias,...). Each output row is independent of other output rows.
equivalence_conditions: Only blocks.3.4.conv2 may use the replacement, with exact active site/module/input/weight/bias identity and existing explicit_gemm policy. Every other call delegates to the preserved original function.

Slice the complete neighbor map by output-row range while keeping its V neighbor order. Gather from the complete input feature array using unmodified global indices; do not slice input features, rebase indices, subset coordinates or rebuild native maps per chunk.
Mask the uint32 0xffffffff sentinel before it can index feats. Missing neighbors remain zero and valid duplicate indices remain valid gathers.

Keep the exact existing contiguous weight view and transpose. Adapter names dimensions Co,Kd,Kh,Kw,Ci whereas the pinned function names Co,Kw,Kh,Kd,Ci; the authorized 3x3x3 shape is symmetric, but a new permutation would still change kernel-slot correspondence.
Keep BF16 input/output and the same mm/addmm operation. Replacing fused addmm by mm plus a separate addition is not a rounding-equivalence claim.
Preallocate the complete output tensor and fill every disjoint row slice once, including the short final chunk. Do not concatenate retained chunk outputs or mutate the global input/cache.

Leave SubMConv3dFunction.forward cache construction, full native neighbor map, adapter cache registration and x.replace output unchanged. Original C2S mask, child coordinates and child row order must remain unchanged.

Install/restore the actual staticmethod descriptor in finally and preserve its exact source identity. Drop chunk temporaries before the next chunk; preserved exceptions and callback closures must not retain GPU tensors after teardown.
C2S_and_adapter: Original C2S lines 75-88 uses boolean nonzero order, repeat_interleave of parents and idx*8+subidx feature gather. Original sparse adapter lines 37-59 passes full x.feats/x.coords/weight to the native wrapper, registers the original cache, and returns x.replace(out). Chunking the later final convolution needs no change to either path.

CPU_qualification.mapping_tests: Require exact shape/dtype/order and exact zero-fill/global-index behavior on deterministic representable fixtures, including neighbors outside the current output chunk, sentinels, bias and no-bias, and a non-divisible tail. Small exactly representable fixtures can demand exact output equality.
CPU_qualification.numerical_tolerance: No universal tolerance is proved by this source. Changing GEMM M can change BLAS kernel selection/reduction and rounded BF16 outputs even though the real-arithmetic expression is identical. For selected finite bounded CPU fixtures, declare a tight dtype-aware tolerance before the test, report actual max absolute/relative errors, and keep structural mapping assertions exact. BF16 spacing is about 1/128 relative within each binade; a one-ULP-oriented fixture criterion is useful but is not a universal bound near cancellation or zero. Do not loosen a failed criterion automatically.
CPU_qualification.scope: A CPU fixture comparison establishes those fixtures and row/index construction, not bitwise equivalence or a numerical error bound for the full HIP decoder. Same torch API does not independently establish the backend accumulation mode.

memory_and_admission: Full features, coordinates, global neighbor map and full output remain resident. Only im2col, gather, masked indices and GEMM temporaries become row-bounded. Admission must still count global residency plus chunk/downstream lifetimes and unchanged reserves; source equivalence alone does not authorize a row cap or VRAM limit change.
